candidats.titre: File:Construction worker on steel framing of hollywoodHUB at Hollywood Transit Center, Portland, Oregon (January 2026).jpg
candidats.description: A construction worker in safety gear works on metal stud framing high up in the structural grid of the 12-story hollywoodHUB affordable housing development at the Hollywood Transit Center site. This transit-oriented project by BRIDGE Housing and TriMet, featuring 222 units, is under construction with completion expected around 2026–2027.
